blocks.c: The other thing about a renewal with two caretakers in occupation is that the terms have to be re-issued, and re-issued terms have to be agreed, and agreed means signed, and signed means negotiable.
Wen did the drafting. She has had thirty-one years to think about what she would ask for and it turns out the answer is: not very much, and all of it extremely specific.
AGREED TERMS, MERRIDEW TOWER, EXECUTED 3 MAY:

items: No collection against any party without a written notice served in advance, in ink, in the current Record, at least seven days before the item is taken.
Two caretakers at all times. If one leaves the position, the position is vacant, not transferred. It cannot be filled by inattention.
Anyone who enters the premises is a visitor and not a party. Visitors sign in and out. The book is on the desk. It is now a normal book.
The stair stays. The stair is always in the north-east corner and the door always opens outward. This was never in writing and is now.
The inventory is open to the caretakers on request. Any person may recover an item they can identify in writing.

blocks.c: That is the part I still cannot get over. It came round to the front of the counter with a pen, and it signed, and its signature is a small neat old-fashioned hand, and afterwards it said the only unguarded thing I ever heard it say.
It said: "Nobody has ever negotiated. In a hundred and fifty-one years. They all either ran or signed."
